"""
Extract text from the first page of a PDF and save it to an Excel file.
Uses direct text extraction first; falls back to Tesseract OCR if the page
contains no selectable text (e.g. scanned images).
"""

import sys
import pymupdf                 # PDF handling
import pytesseract              # OCR fallback
from PIL import Image
from openpyxl import Workbook
from io import BytesIO

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────
PDF_PATH   = "/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.pdf"
EXCEL_PATH = "/workspace/ocr_result.xlsx"
PAGE_INDEX = 0   # first page

# ── 1. Open the PDF and grab the first page ─────────────────────
doc  = pymupdf.open(PDF_PATH)
page = doc[PAGE_INDEX]

# ── 2. Try direct text extraction ───────────────────────────────
text = page.get_text().strip()
method = "direct extraction"

# ── 3. Fall back to OCR if no selectable text ───────────────────
if not text:
    pix = page.get_pixmap(dpi=300)
    img = Image.open(BytesIO(pix.tobytes("png")))
    text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img).strip()
    method = "Tesseract OCR"

doc.close()

print(f"Extraction method : {method}")
print(f"Characters found  : {len(text)}")
print(f"--- Extracted text ---\n{text}\n")

# ── 4. Write to Excel ───────────────────────────────────────────
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Page 1 Text"

ws["A1"] = "Source PDF"
ws["B1"] = PDF_PATH

ws["A2"] = "Page"
ws["B2"] = PAGE_INDEX + 1

ws["A3"] = "Method"
ws["B3"] = method

ws["A4"] = "Extracted Text"
ws["B4"] = text

# Auto-fit column A width for readability
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 18
ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 80

wb.save(EXCEL_PATH)
print(f"✅  Saved to {EXCEL_PATH}")
